title: Shelf — one Math Engine, uprights, boards and bays
description:
A parametric SHELF UNIT on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. On a wall segment it takes the wall's direction, so a bookcase against a wall runs along it.

FLOOR OR WALL IS ONE VARIABLE. `_base` is the elevation the whole unit is built from — the plinth height when it stands on the floor, the mount height when it hangs — and every board, upright and divider is expressed in it. Nothing else in the body changes, and the plinth switches itself off in the wall case because `_pl` is zeroed by the same ternary. The footprint metric reports 0 for a wall unit, which is the honest answer for something that touches no floor.

BOARDS INCLUDE THE TOP AND THE BOTTOM. `arange(n) * (H - t) / (n - 1)` spreads n boards from the very bottom to the very top rather than dividing the space between them, so a count of 2 gives a top and a base and nothing in between — the degenerate case reads correctly instead of collapsing.

BAYS ARE DIVIDERS + 1. Asking for b bays emits b−1 vertical dividers at `(arange(b-1) + 1) * W / b`, centred on the division line rather than starting at it, so the bays either side of a divider are equal.

CLEAR BAY HEIGHT IS A METRIC, not a dimension you set — board pitch minus board thickness, which is the number that decides what actually fits on the shelf. Storage volume follows from it.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped; each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD and the boards span between the uprights.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 0.90 × 0.30 × 1.80 m, five boards at a 0.446 m pitch giving 0.428 m of clear bay, 2.59 m of shelf run.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Boards are full-depth and full-width within their bay — no stepped or staggered shelving. The wall mounting is an elevation, not a bracket: nothing fixes it to the wall.

props.name: Semantics
props.value: open shelving unit, light oak boards, airy, minimal

params.name: Shelf maths
params.expr:
_natL = width
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Wd = width * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_t = boardThk * _s
_pl = mount == 'Wall' ? 0 : plinthHeight * _s
_base = mount == 'Wall' ? mountHeight * _s : _pl
_u0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_u1 = _Wd / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_v1 = _Dp / 2
_z0 = _base
_z1 = _base + _Ht
_bodyL = _Wd
_bodyW = _Dp
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Uprights — the two ends
_S1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v1, _u0, _v1, _z0, _z1, 1)
_S2 = hcat(_u1 - _t, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _t, _v1, _z0, _z1, 1)
# Shelf boards — n boards spanning the uprights, top and bottom included
_nsh = max(2, round(shelves))
_shz = _z0 + arange(_nsh) * (_Ht - _t) / (_nsh - 1)
_SH = hcat(fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1), fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1), _shz, _shz + _t, fill(_nsh,1,2))
# Vertical dividers — b bays means b-1 dividers, evenly spaced
_nb = max(1, round(bays))
_ndv = _nb - 1
_dvu = _u0 + (arange(_ndv) + 1) * _Wd / _nb - _t / 2
_DV = hcat(_dvu, fill(_ndv,1,_v0), _dvu + _t, fill(_ndv,1,_v0), _dvu + _t, fill(_ndv,1,_v1), _dvu, fill(_ndv,1,_v1), fill(_ndv,1,_z0 + _t), fill(_ndv,1,_z1 - _t), fill(_ndv,1,3))
# Back panel and plinth
_BKr = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v1 - _t / 2, _u1 - _t, _v1 - _t / 2, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _z0, _z1, 4)
_BK = back > 0 ? _BKr : zeros(0, 11)
_PLr = hcat(_u0, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _u1, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _pl, 5)
_PL0 = _pl > 0.001 ? _PLr : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_S1, _S2, _SH, _DV, _BK, _PL0)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Uprights3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Boards3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Dividers3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Back3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Plinth3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
UprightsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BoardsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DividersPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BackPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallWidth = _Wd
overallDepth = _Dp
overallHeight = _Ht
topElevation = _z1
boardCount = _nsh
bayWidth = (_Wd - 2 * _t - _ndv * _t) / _nb
bayHeight = (_Ht - _t) / (_nsh - 1) - _t
shelfRun = (_nsh - 2) * (_Wd - 2 * _t)
storageVolume = shelfRun * _Dp * bayHeight
footprint = mount == 'Wall' ? 0 : (_Wd * _Dp)
